content.rendered:
One body. One Spirit. One hope. One Lord. One faith. One baptism. One God and Father of all. The church is not many things. It is one. And you belong.

The Gospel For Today | Sunday, June 14, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called; one Lord, one faith, one baptism; one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.”
Ephesians 4:4-6 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Read this passage slowly and the word that keeps appearing is one. Seven times in three short verses. One body. One Spirit. One hope. One Lord. One faith. One baptism. One God and Father. Paul is not stuttering. He is hammering. The church the Spirit birthed is not a federation of denominations that have arrived at a working alliance. It is one body, animated by one Spirit, in love with one Lord, indwelt by one Father. The oneness is not a goal we are aiming for. The oneness is the reality we are catching up with.

This is the perfect way to close out a series on life in the Spirit. Because everything the Spirit does in you is also being done in believers you have never met. The same Spirit who is helping you pray today is helping a sister in Nairobi pray today. The same Spirit who is renewing your inner being is renewing a brother in Mexico City. The same Spirit who is filling you with power for endurance is filling a believer in northern Iraq with the same power. You are not isolated. You are one of a body that spans the globe.

And the implication of one body is one belonging. There is no Christian who is more in than another. The new convert in your row at church is in the same body as the apostles who walked with Jesus. The body is one. The Spirit is one. The Lord is one. And every believer is in.

This is also the most powerful argument against the kind of divisions that have plagued the global church. Tribal divisions. Political divisions. Denominational divisions. Worship-style divisions. Generational divisions. Race divisions. All real. None of them stronger than the seven ones of Ephesians 4. Where the New Testament has spoken, the divisions have to bend.

So today, lift your eyes from your particular pew to the global body you belong to. Pray for believers in places you have never been. Thank God that the Spirit who is filling you is filling them. Worship the one Lord who is over all and through all and in all. One body. One Spirit. One Lord. One Father. And you belong.

Prayer

Father, thank You that I am part of one body, animated by Your one Spirit, in love with Your one Son, indwelt by You who are over all, through all and in all. Today I thank You for the believers I worship with, and for the believers I have never met whose faith I share. Make Your church one in heart and one in mission. Let the world know we belong to You by the love we have for one another. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I belong to one body, animated by one Spirit, in love with one Lord, indwelt by one Father. The church I belong to spans every nation and every century. I am not isolated. I am one of many. We are one in Christ.
